'''Drizzlik''' is a [[goblin]] [[quest giver]] located in [[Booty Bay]] in [[Stranglethorn Vale]]. He claims to be the 'finest leathercrafter of the [[South Seas]] and the worlds old and new'. He has adventurers help him complete an order for Excelsior-line boots from [[Director Riddlevox]], though [[Gazlowe]] also ordered boots from him.<ref>{{questlong|Neutral|14|The Missing Shipment}}</ref>
